TT.name: Telegraphic Transfer
TT.description: Bank wire transfer. Most common for export deals.
TT.notes: Request 30% deposit, balance against copy BL or before release.

LC.name: Letter of Credit
LC.description: Bank-backed guarantee. Preferred for large orders or new buyers.
LC.notes: Irrevocable LC at sight via a recognised bank.

SWIFT.name: SWIFT Transfer
SWIFT.description: International bank transfer, same as TT but term used in EU.
SWIFT.notes: Common for Cyprus, Malta, EU-adjacent markets.

EFT.name: Electronic Funds Transfer
EFT.description: Local bank transfer. Common in South Africa and New Zealand.
EFT.notes: Confirm cleared funds before releasing vehicle.

ESCROW.name: Escrow
ESCROW.description: Third-party escrow service. Used for high-value or first-time buyers.
ESCROW.notes: Use for buyers with no track record. Increases trust.
